content: Kawuju i Tana Matuu
Sapadhana incia sumai o Isa abhawea Rohina Aulataʼala apangara i tana matuu mamudhaakana acobaia Ibilisi mokapalaikina manga seetani.
Pata pulu eo, pata pulu malo o Isa apoasa kasiimpo anamisimo kaara.
Ibilisi mowujuna aumba tee apogau, "Roonamo Ingkoo o Anana Aulataʼala, tumpua manga bhatu sii amembali roti."
Maka o Isa alawani, "I nuncana Hukumu Taurati padhamo atoburi, 'Maanusia adhadhi mencuana tangkanamo minaaka i roti, maka minaaka i bhari-bharia firimani ibhoasakana Aulataʼala.' "
Kasiimpo Ibilisi abhawa Isa i Yerusalem, kota mangkilona miana Yahudi tee adhikaia i bumbungana Baitulla.

Pogauna Ibilisi, "Roonamo Ingkoo Anana Aulataʼala, pakotibua o karomu i tambe sii! Roonamo padhamo atoburi i nuncana Kitabi Momangkilo, 'Aulataʼala bheatumpu manga malaaʼekatina to ajaganiko,' tee uka, 'Manga malaaʼekati bheatanampeakako tee limana mamudhaakana o aemu inda akangkanai bhatu.' "
Isa apogau, "Dhaangia uka motoburina i nuncana Hukumu Taurati, 'Bholi uʼuji Kawasana Opu, Aulataʼalamu.' "
Kasiimpo Ibilisi abhawa Isa i bhawona gunu momalanga mpuu tee apakamataakea bhari-bharia pamarinta i dunia sii tee sagala giu kamuliangina.
Apogaumo Ibilisi, "Bhari-bharia sumai kudhawuakea to Ingkoo, somanamo Ingkoo usuju tee usombaaku."
Kasiimpo Isa alawani, "Dhencumo Ibilisi! Roonamo i nuncana Hukumu Taurati padhamo atoburi, 'Sombamo i Kawasana Opu, Aulataʼalamu tee tangkanamo i Incia usambahea.' "
Sabutuna o Ibilisi sumai adhencumo minaaka i Isa tee manga malaaʼekati aumbamo to alaiania.
Isa Apepuungi Karajaana i Galilea
Wakutuuna Isa arango Nabii Yahya atorako, Incia alingkamo i Poropinsi Galilea.
Incia abholi kampo Nazaret kasiimpo amboore i kampo Kapernaum modhaangiana i saripina Tawo Galilea i Tana Zebulon tee Tana Naftali.
Tee mboo sumai amondomo Firimani ipakawaakana Nabii Yesaya,

content.text: dhala i tawo, i sawetana Umala Yordan
i lipuna Galilea, tampa imbooresina manga lipu mosagaanana mencuana miana Israel.
Manga mia momboorena i nuncana kalalanda
tee manga mia momboorena isalibumbuna ajalana,

content: Minaaka i wakutuu incia sumai o Isa apepuumo apakoleleaka, "Tobamo, roonamo Pamarintana Aulataʼala amakasumo!"
Isa Akemba Manga Murina Bhaa-bhaana

Wakutuuna Isa tangasaana adhala i bhiwina Tawona Galilea, Incia akamatamo rua mia umane mopowitinai, siitumo Simon isarongiaka uka Petrus tee Andreas o witinaina. Manga incia tangasaana atudhaaka jalana i tawo, roonamo manga incia sii o pande jalana ikane.
Kasiimpo Isa apogau i manga incia, "Maimo ose Iaku tee bhekupamembalikomiu o pande jalana maanusia."
Manga incia alausaka abholia o jalana kasiimpo aose Incia.

Isa alingka torosu kasiimpo akamatamo rua mia umane mopowitinai mosagaanana, sarona o Yakub tee Yahya. Manga incia apoose tee amana mokosaroakana Zabdi tangasaana alape-lape jalana i nuncana bhangka. Isa akembamo manga incia uka,
sabutuna manga incia alausaka abholia o bhangkana tee abholi o amana kasiimpo aose Isa.
Isa Aadhari tee Apaunto Panyakina Manga Mia Bhari

Isa alingka atipua bhari-bharia lipu i Poropinsi Galilea. Incia aadhari i manga tampana ibaadatina miana Yahudi tee apakawaaka Lele Malape Pamarintana Aulataʼala, tee apaunto sagala giuna panyaki tee apaunto kapiina manga mia mobalacina badana.

Lelena Isa atorango i saangua lipuna Poropinsi Siria. Kasiimpo manga mia mokopanyaki, mia mosukara, mia ipesuaikina seetani, mia ikangkanaina kapii mate manu tee o mia morempa abhawea i aroana, bhari-bharia manga mia incia sumai apauntoa o kapiina.

Abhari mpuu o mia moosea i wakutuu incia sumai. Dhaangia moumbana minaaka i Poropinsi Galilea, dhaangia mominaakana i Dekapolis, mominaakana i Yerusalem, mominaakana i Yudea, tee mominaakana i sawetana Umala Yordan.
